best_parts: node adult_t36: names the tempting memory reason (nines stick to any small patch), refutes it by region, and offers a 'Show me the full chart' deeper route as a second explanation
node child_num_t36: diagnoses the mixed-model error ('once one region looks right, the other feels right too') and tells the learner to use one age rule for every region
node adult_chart / child_chart: explain nodes that are reached by agency after a miss, so remediation differs from the probe's first explanation
flaws: node adult_t36 and adult_t37: feedback states component values (perineum 1%, head 9%) before 'Try again' returns to the same probe, so the retry is partly handed over
node adult_q: the key 28 is the numeric outlier between the twin distractors 36 and 37, a form cue a tired student can use
whole segment: no fast lane; a confident expert must click through four probes and the chart explanations, and no node lets a correct, confident answer skip the explanation

best_parts: node figures: retests the perineum figure with no chart shown, a genuinely different form from the adult probe, so recovery is credited only on re-test
node close: sum-check probe where each wrong total is one region error (head 18 gives 109, perineum 9 gives 108), so the path shows which region the learner misassigns
node contrast: adult and child charts side by side with a device line ('Toddler: big head, short legs'), placed after the probes; this is the contrasting-case technique the blueprint preferred
node child_t6b / figures_t18: feedback follows the full contract shape (Tempting: ... Why it fails: ... what is right) with a sure_note for confident errors
flaws: nodes adult_t22a and adult_t22b: feedback gives the total ('Head and neck 9, anterior trunk 18, perineum 1 gives 28%') before the retry of the same probe, so the retry is answered by the feedback
node pair: two options, one trap; the stem's age cue makes the key almost findable, so this is the weakest probe of the segment
nodes adult_t22a, figures_t9, child_t6a: feedback offers only 'Try again'; there is no second explanation or deeper route after a miss, and no fast lane for confident experts
node counts: O5 (what counts toward TBSA) is taught but never probed on this segment's path

best_parts: node case: a narrative stem (34-year-old after a kitchen fire) frames the TBSA estimate as a clinical moment, the most authentic opener of the three
node child_p: the palm method is kept as a named look-alike and its refutation links back to the age-based chart, a clear partial distractor
node kids: a numbers retest of the child figures after the probe-and-feedback in a different form (no options about method), which is a good delayed re-test
flaws: nodes perin_t22a and perin_t22b: feedback ends 'Right: 1%.' and then 'Try again' returns to the same probe, so the answer is handed over; the hint ladder is broken here
node kids_t6 and kids_p1: 'Right: 18 + 14 = 32%.' and 'Right: 18% for the head and 14% for one leg, so 32%' give the sum before the retry of the same probe

node case_t22a: the feedback repeats the full adult chart as 'Right: head and neck 9, front of trunk 18, perineum 1, which is 28%', so the feedback does two jobs and the node carries more than one idea
node child_p: the palm method is the weakest distractor here; a learner holding the adult model picks the adult rule of nines before the palm, so the option adds little diagnosis
probes case, perin and kids: the key is the first option in three of four probes, a position pattern a tired student can learn
whole segment: no deeper or second-explanation route after a miss and no fast lane

merge_ideas: b's contract-shaped trap feedback and its no-chart figures retest, with a's deeper 'Show me the chart' route after a miss, so a miss gets both a different explanation and a delayed re-test in another form
a's child_num_t36 mixed-model diagnosis line with b's close sum-check, where each wrong total names one region error
c's narrative case stem as the opener of b's sequence, so the clinical moment comes before the first chart probe
all three: feedback names the wrong model and the repair but does not state the total or the key value before the retry of the same probe; re-test the answer in a later probe, not here
key placement varied across probes (not first in most); add a fast lane that lets a confident correct answer on the first probe skip the chart explanation
